_comment: Human-owned metadata merged into the generated metric manifest by
gen-metric-manifest.py. The generated fields (name/type/labels/file/line)
come from tools/metric-manifest AST extraction and are never hand-edited.
activation codes: E eager scalar; V lazy vector children; P pre-created
children; C QoS custom collector (sample-lazy); H eager TTFB histogram;
Q quota-lazy collector; DP datapath-gated scalar; D runtime DPU-gated;
BD doca-build-gated; T TTFT-window-lazy; S startup-created child.
Combined codes (D+P etc.) apply both behaviors.
_comment_desc_runtime_types: Families defined via prometheus.NewDesc. The constructor cannot state the metric type, so the extractor resolves it from the MustNewConstMetric/MustNewConstHistogram site that consumes the Desc. Pinned here so a wrong resolution -- a counter silently becoming a gauge -- fails generation instead of shipping.

coverage_waivers.loxilb_ai_engine_info: Info metric (constant 1) for PromQL joins and legend enrichment of engine identity; standalone display would duplicate configuration.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_ai_token_quota_model_limit_tokens: Join denominator behind the dashboarded quota-utilization ratios; displaying raw configured limits duplicates config, utilization panels answer headroom.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_autopersist_consecutive_failures: Is auto-persist silently failing so config changes would not survive a restart? Interim: loxilb_config_dirty held at 1 across the debounce window surfaces the same exposure. Panel + alert arrive with the persistence-panel extension in the config generation follow-up.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_boot_legacy_fallback_total: Did a boot degrade to legacy txt config replay? Interim: LoxilbRestore alerts cover the failed snapshot path that precedes the fallback, and boot logs record the arbitration. Panel arrives with the persistence-panel extension in the config generation follow-up.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_closed_connections_processed_tota: Internal conntrack-sweep finalization bookkeeping; a stall surfaces as missing closed-flow traffic in the dashboarded counters — diagnostic query only.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_endpoint_traffic_bytes_total: Superseded on dashboards by loxilb_backend_traffic_bytes_total (exact DP counters, ip:port attribution); kept exported for persistent-flow comparison and external consumers.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_errors_total: Instance-level aggregate of loxilb_service_errors_total, which is dashboarded; sum() of the per-service sibling answers it exactly.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_host_cpu_utilization_percent: Legacy duplicate of loxilb_system_cpu_utilization_percent, which the overview CPU/Memory/Disk panel shows; kept exported for older external dashboards.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_ipfilter_blacklist_bytes_total: Byte-volume twin of the dashboarded ipfilter packet counters; filter verdicts are judged by packet counts, byte volume stays an ad-hoc query.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_ipfilter_whitelist_bytes_total: Byte-volume twin of the dashboarded ipfilter packet counters; filter verdicts are judged by packet counts, byte volume stays an ad-hoc query.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_lb_rule_interaction_bytes_total: Flow-identity (service x sip x dip) forensic counter with unbounded client cardinality; deliberately not dashboarded — client-traffic and per-backend panels answer the operational question, ad-hoc query for forensics.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_lb_rule_interaction_packets_total: Flow-identity (service x sip x dip) forensic counter with unbounded client cardinality; deliberately not dashboarded — client-traffic and per-backend panels answer the operational question, ad-hoc query for forensics.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_pd_ep_info: Info metric (constant 1) mapping ep_idx to endpoint IP for PromQL joins; standalone display would duplicate configuration.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_persist_total: Did the last persist attempts succeed? Interim: the config persistence API (GET /config/persist/status) reports last-persist outcome, and loxilb_config_dirty staying 1 exposes a persist that never lands. Panel arrives with the persistence-panel extension shipped alongside the config generation gauge follow-up.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_processed_packets_total: Aggregate of the per-protocol packet counters already dashboarded on Packets/s by protocol; sum() over those series answers it exactly.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_processed_sctp_bytes_total: Per-protocol byte split of total throughput; the Throughput (DP bytes) and Packets/s-by-protocol panels answer the question — per-proto bytes stay an ad-hoc query.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_processed_tcp_bytes_total: Per-protocol byte split of total throughput; the Throughput (DP bytes) and Packets/s-by-protocol panels answer the question — per-proto bytes stay an ad-hoc query.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_processed_udp_bytes_total: Per-protocol byte split of total throughput; the Throughput (DP bytes) and Packets/s-by-protocol panels answer the question — per-proto bytes stay an ad-hoc query.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_security_udp_bytes_passed_total: Byte twin of the dashboarded UDP passed/blocked packet counters and blocked-bytes panel; passed-byte volume adds no verdict signal.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_service_traffic_packets_total: Per-service packet twin of the dashboarded bytes counter; the exact per-backend packets/s panel covers the packet-rate question with finer attribution.
coverage_waivers.loxilb_snapshot_quarantine_total: Did a boot quarantine an unreplayable snapshot.json? Interim: quarantine events land in the gateway log and loxilb_boot_legacy_fallback_total or restore alerts fire on the same boot path. Panel arrives with the persistence-panel extension in the config generation follow-up.

_comment_runtime_scope: Where a family can appear at runtime at all -- a different question from whether this release qualifies it. Published per family as runtime_scope so a consumer can tell 'absent because the profile is not deployed' from 'absent because nothing has driven it yet'.

_comment: This release develops and qualifies only the 176 gateway-default families.
The other 56 are RELEASE-EXCLUDED-EXPERIMENTAL: they may stay in source, but
no default dashboard, alert rule, scrape job, or release test may depend on
them. That property holds today; this block locks it so reintroducing a
dependency fails in CI instead of at release acceptance.
Each surface must match at least one file -- a scan that reads nothing would
pass forever and prove nothing -- and the inventory files that legitimately
list every family by name are exempted explicitly, not by pattern.
excluded_consumer_scan._note_surfaces: e2e/ holds no test sources in this repo (only CLAUDE.md), so it is not listed -- a surface that matches nothing is rejected rather than carried as decoration. Per-owner Go unit tests of the excluded features (api/prometheus/aictrl_metrics_test.go, pkg/loxinet/dpu_metrics_test.go) are deliberately out of scope: exercising an excluded family in its own package is not a release dependency on it.

_comment: WP-0 of the metric coverage campaign. Per packaged family: the reviewed,
ordered chain of Go symbols from the metric constructor to a production
entry point. gen-metric-manifest.py re-verifies every recorded anchor
against the source tree on each run, so this is a claim that decays loudly
rather than a comment that rots quietly.
Why it is stored rather than derived: on 2026-09-10 a 'zero callers' query
classified four live loxilb_parser_* families as dead. The query was right
about the symbol it was handed (ParseWithTimeoutOrDefault) and wrong about
the families, because that symbol is a method on PluginRegistry while the
production path runs through TraceParserRegistry. The two facts that would
have caught it -- the receiver type of each method hop, and the transitive
chain up to an entry point -- do not survive in a query result, so they are
recorded here and reviewed by a human.
Chain shape. writer_sources[0] is the function that touches the family's
constructor; it records def_line (its own 'func' line) and writes (the
constructor variable it must mention). Every later hop records def_line for
itself plus call_line/calls for the call it makes into the previous hop,
and the last hop declares entry_point. kind='method' always requires
receiver. data_sources is the same shape, for collector-backed families
whose values are refreshed on a separate path from the one that emits them.
status: verified-runtime (observed emitting real values on a bed, value
checked) | conditional-with-proven-writer (writer proven in source, family
stays absent until a named precondition is met) | verified-static (writer
proven in source and driven by a test, not yet seen on a bed) |
definition-only (reviewed and accepted as having no production writer;
must list the exact symbols queried, with receivers).
burndown.unclassified_max is a one-way ratchet. The gate fails when more
families are unclassified than the ceiling AND when the ceiling sits above
the real count, so classifying families forces it down and it cannot drift
back up. At 0 this is exactly the gate WP-0 specifies. The number is the
honest measure of how much of the metric contract is actually reviewed.

burndown._note: 176 packaged families, 17 classified on 2026-09-10 (the parser group corrected in the plan's 0.3.1, the AI CGO denial/token writers from A.3, and the QoS shaper group measured in B.5b). Lower this as families are reviewed; never raise it.

writer_status._note_unverifiable_roots: Paths whose anchors are recorded but not checked, because CI checks out the main tree only (monitoring-lint.yml sets submodules: false). Shape is still validated; the line is a reviewed reference, not a verified anchor.

loxilb_parser_calls_total.activation_precondition: a tracing catalog with deep_inspection.enabled=true and a non-empty parser_type (pkg/loxinet/catalog.go), synced to the datapath by catalog_sync.go. Absent on a bed with no such catalog, which proves nothing about the writer.

writer_sources.note: success branch; the error/timeout/panic branch calls the same helper at :145

loxilb_parser_calls_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section 0.3.1 -- source re-verification 2026-09-10 that withdrew the DEFINED-WRITER-UNWIRED finding

loxilb_parser_duration_seconds.activation_precondition: a tracing catalog with deep_inspection.enabled=true and a non-empty parser_type (pkg/loxinet/catalog.go); observed on the same call as loxilb_parser_calls_total.

loxilb_parser_body_size_bytes.activation_precondition: a tracing catalog with deep_inspection.enabled=true and a non-empty parser_type; the body must also be under the catalog's max_body_size for a sample to be recorded.

loxilb_parser_attributes_extracted_total.activation_precondition: a tracing catalog with deep_inspection.enabled=true and a non-empty parser_type; the writer additionally returns early when the parser extracted zero attributes, so a successful parse of an attribute-free payload leaves this family absent.

loxilb_ai_rate_limit_hits_total.activation_precondition: an API-key store (--aikey-db-* flags) plus --api-key-auth=required on the LB rule, and a key whose rps/burst is actually exceeded. With no key store no request carries a tenant, so the denial can never fire.

writer_sources.note: llb_ai_token_quota_reserve records the same family at ai_gateway_dp.go:756 with reason token_quota_would_exceed

loxilb_ai_rate_limit_hits_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section A.3 -- weak-stub tripwire never logged on the running gateway, so the strong Go CGO exports are the bound symbols

loxilb_ai_model_not_allowed_total.activation_precondition: an API-key store plus --api-key-auth=required on the LB rule, and a request naming a model outside the key's --allowed-models list (decision == 2, HTTP 403).
loxilb_ai_model_not_allowed_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section A.3 -- CGO call-site table, verified against ai_gateway_dp.go at 4d1f8a24

loxilb_ai_tokens_consumed_total.activation_precondition: a tenant with --tokens-per-min set on an API-key-enabled rule, and a completed response the quota path charges. The writer returns early when prompt+completion is zero, so a charge of nothing leaves the family absent.
loxilb_ai_tokens_consumed_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section A.3 -- CGO call-site table; exact-delta assertions specified in WP-2

loxilb_ai_tokens_estimated_total.activation_precondition: the same quota path as loxilb_ai_tokens_consumed_total, additionally on the estimated branch -- the response carried no usage object, so the data plane priced the charge from its own estimate.
loxilb_ai_tokens_estimated_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section A.3; WP-2's red twin is the no-usage backend that drives exactly this branch

loxilb_ai_tokens_missing_total.activation_precondition: the same estimated branch as loxilb_ai_tokens_estimated_total -- one increment per response that carried no usage object.
loxilb_ai_tokens_missing_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section A.3; WP-2 asserts this equals the number of no-usage responses exactly

writer_sources.note: registry-mediated dispatch: the link is the receiver type handed to prometheus.MustRegister, not a direct call to Collect

loxilb_proxy_qos_bytes_passed_total.evidence: docs/internal/METRICS-COVERAGE-GAP-RCA-AND-PLAN.md section B.5b, run 'WP-3 QoS' 2026-09-09 on llbigw-2: bytes_passed 46758599 against curl's 46758393 (+206 HTTP headers). The writer path is proven; WP-3 sign-off is separately blocked by defect D-3.
